data.narrative: In Module 05 (Iteration Patterns), Alekhya demonstrated disciplined engineering execution by implementing the real-time activity feed under the Two-Iteration Rule. When the initial generation suffered from fundamental structural gaps in channel multiplexing and lifecycle management, she resisted the sunk-cost trap and executed an early restart with a refined architectural prompt. This disciplined context management prevented quality spirals, converging to a production-ready pub/sub service with 26 passing automated tests in just 3 iterations.

dimension_scores.observation: Mastered the boundary between surface-level expression issues (refine) and structural architectural flaws (restart early).
dimension_scores.evidence: Correctly diagnosed that channel isolation and replay state could not be patched onto a flat broadcast bus, triggering an immediate restart.
